# FoxTerm

> FoxTerm is a high-performance, fully native All-in-One terminal and server management suite designed exclusively for macOS and iOS/iPadOS, combining SSH, SFTP, VNC, container management, and live server monitoring into a single privacy-first client.

> - Official Website: https://foxterm.app/
> - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/foxterm/id6760452891 (Universal Purchase, App ID 6760452891)
> - Platforms: macOS 14.0+ and iOS/iPadOS 17.0+ only — no Windows, Android, or Linux desktop build
> - Tech Stack: 100% native Swift + Metal, C-native libraries (OpenSSL, libssh, libvncclient); no Electron, no web wrappers
> - Privacy: strict zero-telemetry policy — no analytics, no activity tracking, no connection logs, no traffic proxying
> - Security: credentials and SSH private keys hardware-isolated in Apple Secure Enclave & Keychain; config sync only via the user's encrypted private iCloud container
> - Protocols: SSH, SFTP, VNC, Docker API, Podman API (over SSH)
> - Licensing: Free edition with a capped managed-node limit; FoxTerm Pro unlocks unlimited nodes
> - Localization: 10 languages served from localized URL paths (e.g. /zh-hans/, /de/, /ja/)
> - Related hubs: blog.foxterm.app (development blog), security.foxterm.app (advisories), github.com/foxterm (open source)

## Product Overview

FoxTerm unifies five workloads in one native client: SSH terminal access, SFTP file management, Metal-accelerated VNC remote desktop, real-time Linux server telemetry, and visual Docker/Podman container control. It connects directly from the device to the user's own servers — traffic is never proxied through FoxTerm infrastructure.

## Key Capabilities

- **SSH & terminal:** low-latency 256-color UTF-8 shell, Ed25519 and modern ciphers, multi-pane split sessions, command snippets, auto-reconnect.
- **SFTP file management:** integrated file browser with drag-and-drop transfers, inline text editing, POSIX permission tuning.
- **Metal-accelerated VNC:** GPU-rendered fluid remote desktop with advanced multi-touch gestures.
- **Live telemetry:** real-time CPU, RAM, disk I/O, network, GPU, and VRAM diagnostics for managed Linux nodes.
- **Container control:** visual dashboards for Docker and Podman — rootless execution, log streaming, one-click exec shells, management of containers, images, and volumes.

## Security & Privacy

- **Zero telemetry:** no analytics, no activity tracking, no connection logs, no remote reporting.
- **Local encryption:** all credentials and keys are encrypted 100% on-device; server passwords and SSH private keys are hardware-isolated inside Apple Keychain and Secure Enclave.
- **No proxying:** all connections go directly from the device to the user's servers; FoxTerm never sees or routes traffic.
- **Encrypted sync:** multi-device configuration synchronization is processed exclusively through the user's private, encrypted iCloud container.

## Platforms & Compatibility

- **Supported:** macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) or later; iOS/iPadOS 17.0 or later (iPhone and iPad).
- **Not supported:** Windows, Android, Linux desktop. FoxTerm is engineered exclusively for the native Apple stack.
- **Purchase parity:** a single Universal Purchase unlocks the same license on macOS and iOS/iPadOS under one Apple ID.

## Pricing & Licensing

- **Free edition:** feature-complete (all capabilities unlocked, not a crippled demo); the only limit is the maximum number of managed remote nodes.
- **FoxTerm Pro — App Store edition:** monthly or yearly subscription billed by Apple (governed by Apple's policies); automatically activates the iOS app via Universal Purchase; manage or cancel in Apple ID subscription settings; renewals and refunds handled by Apple.
- **FoxTerm Pro — Notarized edition:** direct, signed macOS build (no App Store dependency) unlocked with an activation code purchased at https://pay.foxterm.app/; applies to macOS only.
- **Storefront:** [Purchase Pro licenses](https://pay.foxterm.app/) — activation keys for the Notarized macOS edition.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **What is the difference between free and Pro?** Free unlocks every feature but caps the number of manageable nodes; Pro removes the cap for unlimited nodes.
- **Does FoxTerm collect data or route traffic?** No — strict zero-telemetry, direct device-to-server connections, no proxying, no analytics, no logs.
- **How are server keys secured?** Credentials and SSH private keys are encrypted on-device and isolated in Apple Keychain and Secure Enclave.
- **Why is it faster than Electron-based terminals?** Built from scratch with native Swift, Metal hardware acceleration, and C-native libraries — near-instant startup and ultra-low resource usage.
- **Which protocols are supported?** SSH, SFTP, VNC, plus Docker and Podman engine management over SSH, with Ed25519 and modern ciphers.
- **How does Pro activation work on macOS?** Either the App Store subscription (auto-activates iOS via Universal Purchase) or a Notarized-edition activation code from pay.foxterm.app (macOS only).
